comment: INIT-011 EPIC-028: which human-facing root documents are mirrored into which languages, and how each mirror stays honest. READMEs are held current by the push-gate status-badge and version-in-prose checks; the smaller root docs carry a synced-to digest pin equal to the SHA-256 of their English source, so a translation cannot silently drift from the bytes it was translated from. LICENSE and NOTICE are the authoritative legal texts and are deliberately NOT translated; CHANGELOG.md and SUPPORT.md are English-only for now.
